message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 (APOE) in Europeans**

| Population | Minor allele (T) frequency |
|------------|-----------------------------|
| Non‑Finnish European (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **≈ 12 %** |
| Finnish European (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **≈ 9 %** |

*The “minor” allele here is the T allele at rs7412; the major allele is C. The frequency of the T allele in the broader European population (including both Finnish and non‑Finnish subgroups) is roughly 10–12 %.*

**Sources**

- gnomAD v2.1.1 allele frequencies (https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/)
- ExAC database (pre‑gnomAD) reports similar frequencies (~11 % in Europeans).

These figures reflect the proportion of chromosomes carrying the T allele in large, well‑characterized European cohorts.
